svg.aria-label: Wooden wayfinder signpost with cottage, shop and pond icons
svg.title: Wayfinder signpost: cottage, shop, pond (all point right)

g.desc: Top arrow panel (points right): cottage icon with red roof, blue door, chimney, flowers
Middle arrow panel (points right): shop icon with purple striped awning, brown door, flower box
Bottom arrow panel (points right): pond icon with lily pads, cattails, stones, flowers
